<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Food Delivery System">88860ed183ae2a10410a73d6feaad397</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Total Price</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onLoad() {
  try {
    // Get the value of the MRVS
    var rows = JSON.parse(g_form.getValue('menu_items'));
    var total = 0;
    
    // Loop through rows
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var priceText = rows[i].food_price;
	  alert("Inside loop"); // 'price' is the variable inside MRVS
      if (priceText) {
        var price = parseFloat(priceText.trim());
        if (!isNaN(price)) {
          total += price;
        }
      }
    }

    // Set total in normal variable
    g_form.setValue('total_price', total.toFixed(2));
  } catch (err) {
     console.log("Error calculating MRVS total: " + err.message);
  }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-10 18:46:14</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>de21329b83aae250410a73d6feaad3b7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Total Price</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Food Delivery System" source="x_946454_food_de_0">d660a9d183ea2a10410a73d6feaad3a7</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Food Delivery System">d660a9d183ea2a10410a73d6feaad3a7</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_de21329b83aae250410a73d6feaad3b7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-10 18:58:07</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>0</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
